name: Love Craft
source:
Dear Student, Congratulations!

We are thrilled to inform you that you have been accepted into Cubiversity!

Meet 15 charming classmates, and join the prestigious Crafting Club, a cozy place to sew together something special!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691640/Love_Craft/]Steam[/url]]

A full rewrite and remake, combining [url=/v60371]Doki Doki Crafting Club[/url] and [url=/v60372]Love Craft[/url] into a single game with 3 new characters.
translation:
亲爱的学生，恭喜你！

我们很高兴地通知你，你已被Cubiversity录取！

认识15位迷人的同学，并加入著名的手工俱乐部，这是一个缝制特别物品的舒适场所！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3691640/Love_Craft/]Steam[/url]]

完全重写和重制，将 [url=/v60371]Doki Doki Crafting Club[/url] 和 [url=/v60372]Love Craft[/url] 合并到一个具有3个新角色的游戏中。
